name: wayfinder-maps
description: A side drawer that shows every wayfinder map and spec in the project (markdown or GitHub issues), their tickets, statuses and dependencies.

workIn.title: Where Work buttons work
workIn.description: new-chat: a new chat with no context. On the desktop the command is copied and a new session opens in this project, to paste it in; in the terminal a window of its own runs it. here: this chat.

mapPrompt.title: Work-the-map prompt
mapPrompt.description: Prompt for 'Work the map', on a map with no ticket ready to take. {map} is the map path or issue URL.

mapTicketPrompt.title: Work-a-map-ticket prompt
mapTicketPrompt.description: Prompt for 'Work next' and 'Work this ticket' on a wayfinder ticket. {map}, {ticket}, {title}.

specTicketPrompt.title: Work-a-spec-ticket prompt
specTicketPrompt.description: Prompt for 'Work this ticket' on an implementation (spec) ticket. {map}, {ticket}, {title}.

specPrompt.title: Implement-the-spec prompt
specPrompt.description: Prompt for 'Implement spec': the whole spec, its frontier tickets built by parallel subagents. {map} is the spec path or issue URL.

frontierPrompt.title: Implement-the-frontier prompt
frontierPrompt.description: Prompt for 'Implement frontier': one wave, the spec's frontier tickets built by parallel subagents, then stop. {map} is the spec path or issue URL.
